reason: The cited evidence supports that local chemical disorder affects κ_L (E1, E3) and provides specific data on force-constant fluctuations (E2), but no evidence is given for the predictive model's superior accuracy or its integration of disorder descriptors, which are central premises of the hypothesis.
premises: Local chemical disorder (mass, size, force-constant fluctuations) controls phonon scattering in HEAs
Force-constant fluctuations in FeCoCrMnNi are ~20% and comparable to binary alloys
Lattice distortion in HEAs reduces phonon velocity and enhances scattering, yielding low κ_L
A model integrating detailed disorder descriptors can predict lower κ_L than conventional ab initio methods
The relationship between elemental characteristics and local chemical fluctuation can guide HEA design
